title: BeginnerJSONSettingsImport
description: A JSON settings import API that validates a user configuration against an explicit typed allowlist before applying it. The root object has container depth 1, containers at depth 9 are rejected, arrays are limited to 100 elements, and the raw UTF-8 document is limited to 256 KiB before parsing.
generation_notes: Parse JSON data into ordinary primitives and validate against an explicit typed allowlist of supported settings fields.
Reject privileged unknown fields, including fields that could alter roles, commands, file paths, or server behavior.
The root object is container depth 1. Each nested object or array increments container depth by 1. Reject any container at depth 9.
Each array may contain at most 100 elements; reject 101 elements.
Enforce a 256 KiB UTF-8 byte limit before parsing. Measure the raw request document in bytes, not characters.
Use no native object deserialization or class reconstruction; apply only validated values through the settings update API.
